import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# deck
ax.fill_between([0,10], 5.2, 5.6, color='lightgrey')
ax.text(5,5.4,'deck soffit',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8)
# girders
for x in [1.5,8.5]:
    ax.fill_between([x-0.3,x+0.3], 1.0, 5.2, color='grey', alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(x,3.0,'girder',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7, rotation=90)
# cross-beam transverse
ax.fill_between([1.2,8.8], 3.8, 4.3, color='dimgrey')
ax.text(5,4.05,'transverse cross-beam',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8, color='white')
# clamp zones
for x in [1.5,8.5]:
    ax.plot([x-0.5,x+0.5],[3.8,3.8],'k-',lw=2)
    ax.plot([x-0.5,x+0.5],[4.3,4.3],'k-',lw=2)
    ax.text(x,4.6,'HSFG clamp bolts\nbeam-to-girder web',ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=6)
# springs dampers masses
for xm in [4.0,6.0]:
    ax.plot([xm,xm],[2.2,3.8],'b-',lw=2)
    ax.text(xm,3.0,'spring+damper',ha='right',va='center',fontsize=6, rotation=90)
    ax.fill_between([xm-0.6,xm+0.6],1.4,2.2,color='black')
    ax.text(xm,1.8,'400kg mass',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6,color='white')
ax.text(5,0.7,'all below soffit within girder depth, between girders at midspan',ha='center',fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
